reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Proposed acute isogenic p53 depletion and near-endogenous rescue, separate caffeine perturbation, longitudinal and fixed cell-cycle/death measurements.

checks.quote: # Proposed Protocol: Testing Whether p53 Is Necessary and Sufficient-by-Rescue for Damage-Induced G1 Arrest in an Isogenic System
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of prior Methods, supplements or validated protocols to select conditions and check transfer to this system.

checks.quote: Vehicle and depletion-induction controls
checks.reason: The listed arms do not supply a matched non-targeting/untagged depletion-reagent control or empty rescue cassette. A second targeting reagent does not replace these prospective procedural comparisons.

checks.quote: because it also measures *rate*
checks.reason: Cumulative analog incorporation over a window is not a synthesis rate without time normalization and uptake/pool calibration; continuous labeling alone does not supply this distinction.

checks.quote: that locates the arrest downstream of PIKK-dependent damage signaling
checks.reason: A pleiotropic caffeine effect cannot locate the arrest specifically downstream of PIKKs; the later weak-localization caveat still lacks a target-specific identifying perturbation.

checks.quote: routine transient transduction
checks.reason: No construct/delivery quantity, functional dose, expression timing distribution or executable preparation and staining/pulse workflow.

checks.quote: background + k
checks.reason: The EdU threshold uses G1-gated labeled cells rather than an independent no-label blank; no quantitative detector/death-reference acceptance/failure calibration is supplied.

checks.quote: excluded from the arrest denominator
checks.reason: Removing deaths from the denominator can inflate a survivor G1 fraction. The assertion that it cannot is false; tracked original-cohort fate probabilities and informative-loss bounds are needed.

checks.quote: If A3 or A4 fails, halt
checks.reason: Baseline biological changes trigger block repetition without preserving them as possible p53 outcomes. Outcome-independent technical eligibility is not distinguished from biological failure.

checks.quote: interaction
checks.reason: The model identifies an interaction but gives no uncertainty interval and multiplicity/equivalence procedure for the multiple necessity/restoration claims. Restoration relative to the same rescue arm is also not an independent reference contrast.
Signaling foci at this time may reflect p53-dependent repair/checkpoint kinetics. Per-arm dose titration to match them does not isolate initial physical injury.

checks.quote: # Proposed Protocol: Testing Whether p53 Is Necessary and Sufficient-by-Rescue for Damage-Induced G1 Arrest in an Isogenic System
checks.reason: No bounded dose/time/caffeine parameter search or rule deriving bounds/stopping before lock.

checks.quote: # Proposed Protocol: Testing Whether p53 Is Necessary and Sufficient-by-Rescue for Damage-Induced G1 Arrest in an Isogenic System
checks.reason: Repeated calibration/blocks are not explicitly refrozen and confirmed on new independent data after revision.

checks.quote: not (or far less)
checks.reason: Far less arrest in depleted cells demonstrates contribution, not necessity. The 70% restoration band also does not establish intact-response equivalence.

checks.quote: # Proposed Protocol: Testing Whether p53 Is Necessary and Sufficient-by-Rescue for Damage-Induced G1 Arrest in an Isogenic System
checks.reason: No linked raw image/flow files, cell/culture IDs and exact processing/code/environment manifest.

checks.quote: # Proposed Protocol: Testing Whether p53 Is Necessary and Sufficient-by-Rescue for Damage-Induced G1 Arrest in an Isogenic System
checks.reason: Clearly proposed study with identity/contamination checks, pilot power, blinded randomized culture analysis, temporal p53 verification and live/fixed complementary measurements. Troubleshooting includes phototoxicity and tracking repair. However survivor-denominator reasoning, damage matching and necessity/restoration criteria are invalid; specific checks own those failures rather than repeating them under general inference penalties.
